# TasteIQ

> Hospitality OS with native property management (rooms, bookings, rates/availability, events, banquets, maintenance, night audit) plus full F&B for restaurants, cafés, bakeries, bars, and hotels—with OTA sync and new-outlet setup journeys (FSSAI, GST, licenses).

## Lead journey (organic → WhatsApp → POS)

1. User searches pain points (FSSAI, open a cafe, bar POS, etc.)
2. Lands on TasteIQ journey/guide pages
3. Clicks WhatsApp CTA (+91 6207466460) for assisted services
4. After compliance/setup, converts to TasteIQ software

Contact: founders@tasteiq.in · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/916207466460

## Categories covered

Restaurants, QSR, takeaway, multi-cuisine, cafés, coffee shops, bakeries, cloud bakeries, sweet shops, juice bars, food courts, bars/pubs, hotel restaurants, boutique hotels, resorts, banquets, room service, OTA/channel management.
